seo_title: Ballroom Dance Academy Case Study: Content Strategy | SOMIN
description: SOMIN found rivals published 402 organic posts to Ballroom Dance Academy's 39 in 90 days, then built it a 3-pillar plan, a 39-post calendar and a paid funnel.
eyebrow: Brand case study · Dance education · Singapore
h1: Ballroom Dance Academy has a publishing problem, not a product problem
lede: SOMIN read 24 months of content from Ballroom Dance Academy Singapore (BDAS) and 4 rivals, plus 53 rival Facebook ads. In 90 days rivals posted 402 times to BDAS's 39; BDAS ran no ads.
meta_line: A SOMIN brand briefing · Jun 2024 to May 2026 · Singapore

challenge.title: Ballroom Dance Academy's classes, out-shouted by 4 rivals
challenge.body: BDAS offers a full class path, from the 4-week Beginner Taster to DanceSport, plus kids classes, wedding preparation and monthly socials.

approach.title: Eight quarters of organic content and 53 rival ads
points: Catalogued BDAS's real classes and events.
Tracked BDAS and 4 rivals over 8 quarterly windows.
Compared themes to find where BDAS can differentiate, reclaim or bet.
Built insight chains for 3 pillars from 11 SOMIN studies.

findings_title: Out-published ten to one and absent from paid ads

findings.title: Out-published 402 posts to 39 in 90 days
findings.body: BDAS holds about 9% of organic share of voice across the 5 academies.

findings.title: Teaching is 26.4% of rival content, 2.6% of BDAS's
findings.body: Despite its tagline, 'An Academy of expert teaching and coaching.'

findings.title: Rival ads chase beginners, and BDAS runs none
findings.body: Kids 43%, confidence 30% and 'anyone can dance' 23% of 53 ads.

delivered.title: Three pillars, 75 creative concepts and a 39-post calendar
points: 3 pillars: The Stage Where Dancers Get Seen, An Academy of Expert Teaching, A Space for All (Anyone Can Dance)
9 propositions, each with a funnel-stage ad concept
75 creative concepts in the BDAS identity
39 posts over 13 weeks: Teaching 16, Recognition 14, Confidence 9
4 paid ad concepts for beginners, kids, classes and weddings

quote.text: Visibility is not BDAS's product problem — it is BDAS's publishing problem.

outcome.title: Ballroom Dance Academy's plan: 3 posts a week and paid ads
outcome.body: BDAS should post 3 times a week, show its expert teaching and lean on the galas and championships rivals cannot copy. In paid, it can mirror the beginner funnel, starting with the low-risk Beginner Taster.

faq.a: The DanceSport Academy, Galaxy Dance Academy, Melvyn Low Dance Studio and Aquilia Dance Academy. Only the first two run Facebook ads.

faq.q: Why open a paid channel now?
faq.a: Rivals' paid themes are ones BDAS already has organic permission for, yet every beginner search in Singapore meets a rival ad, never BDAS.
No. Without an audience-proxy cohort, SOMIN labels themes contested, blocked, emerging or partial, not confirmed whitespace.
